description: This file defines classes and types related to network requests, responses, and WebSocket handling within the Playwright core library. It includes request/response lifecycle management, request interception, and WebSocket event handling.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including headers, method, URL, and related response. Supports request interception and fallback overrides.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, providing access to status, headers, body, and related request.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, handling message events, errors, and connection state.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request routing, interception, and fulfillment within the network layer.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Manages WebSocket route interception and message handling.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteHandler
classes.description: Defines a handler for WebSocket route interception patterns.

classes.name: RouteHandler
classes.description: Manages request/response route handling, including invocation count and expiration.

classes.name: RawHeaders
classes.description: Utility class for managing HTTP headers as an array and map, supporting case-insensitive lookups.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns headers as a Headers object, deprecated in favor of async methods.

methods.name: _actualHeaders
methods.description: Fetches the actual headers from the network response asynchronously.

methods.name: allHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as a Headers object.

methods.name: headersArray
methods.description: Returns headers as an array of name-value pairs.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header by name.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the response body as a Buffer.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the response body as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Parses and returns the response body as a JSON object.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the WebSocket server.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the route handler, optionally ignoring errors.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the route handler pattern.
